user.title: Wake Word Collector
user.description: Record examples of your wake word with your own voice satellites.

data.variants: Also counts as the wake word

data_description.phrase: As your speech-to-text writes it, e.g. Hey Jarvis.
data_description.variants: Comma separated transcriptions that also count, e.g. hey jarvas, hi jarvis. A recording that consists only of these, once or several times, is ready for training; repetitions are split into single clips.
data_description.control_words: Comma separated. Recordings containing them (e.g. "I am done") are kept apart as commands.
data_description.storage: Empty: <config>/wake_word_collector/<wake word>. Recordings are voice data: keep the folder out of public backups.

device_settings.title: Satellite settings
device_settings.description:
Put these into the ESPHome configuration of every satellite (see README):

Upload URL: `{url}`
Token: `{token}`
Command sensor: `sensor.{slug}_satellite_command`

Keep the token secret, e.g. in `secrets.yaml`. It is shown again in the options of this entry.

error.phrase_empty: The wake word must contain at least one letter or digit.

abort.already_configured: This wake word is already set up.
